sprint: Sprint 8: Manifest Consolidation and PDF Wave B Publication Closure

F1_manifest_overwrite.description: write_pr_candidate_manifest() uses open(path, 'w') — overwrites pr-candidate-manifest.json every run. Each run only includes scenarios that were attempted in THAT run. Candidates from prior runs are silently dropped.
F1_manifest_overwrite.impact: XlsConverter (passed in run pilot-pdf-20260514-182836) was overwritten by run pilot-pdf-20260514-190422 which failed XlsConverter. The canonical passing artifact from run 1 was lost from the manifest, even though the run 1 artifacts still exist on disk.
F1_manifest_overwrite.root_cause: build_pr_candidate_manifest() receives example_gates from the current run only. It has no mechanism to read or merge previously passing candidates from prior runs.
F1_manifest_overwrite.fix: LANE 2 — Change write_pr_candidate_manifest() to read existing manifest and merge: new run's passes overwrite; old passes preserved for scenarios not re-attempted or not improved upon.

F2_publish_pr_reads_physical_directory.description: The publish-pr CLI command reads example_dirs from workspace/pr-dry-run/{family}-controlled-pilot/examples/{family}/lowcode/ — a physical directory. It does NOT read pr-candidate-manifest.json for file enumeration.
F2_publish_pr_reads_physical_directory.impact: Wave B examples (DocConverter, XlsConverter, Html) are NOT present in workspace/pr-dry-run/pdf-controlled-pilot/. The directory only contains 'optimizer'. publish-pr would see 0 new Wave B candidates for PR#3.
F2_publish_pr_reads_physical_directory.root_cause: Package assembly is manual — no code automatically copies generated examples from workspace/runs/{run_id}/generated/ to workspace/pr-dry-run/{family}-controlled-pilot/.
F2_publish_pr_reads_physical_directory.fix: LANE 3 — Manually assemble Wave B examples into workspace/pr-dry-run/pdf-controlled-pilot/ by copying source files from correct run directories.

F3_xls_converter_lifecycle_divergence.description: Lifecycle record (latest) for pdf-xls-converter shows run_id=pilot-pdf-20260514-190422, final_verdict=EXAMPLE_BLOCKED_GENERATION_FAILED, pr_candidate=false. But completion queue shows state=PR_READY (based on run pilot-pdf-20260514-182836). These are in conflict.
F3_xls_converter_lifecycle_divergence.root_cause: Run 5 (pilot-pdf-20260514-190422) re-attempted XlsConverter generation and FAILED (post-repair validation errors). The lifecycle registry records only the LATEST attempt. The completion queue was set to PR_READY after run 1 and was NOT updated after run 5 regression.
F3_xls_converter_lifecycle_divergence.fix: LANE 5 — Update lifecycle registry entry for pdf-xls-converter to record regression. Note: completion queue remains PR_READY because the run 1 artifacts are valid and should be packaged.

F4_doc_converter_ambiguity.description: DocConverter was generated in BOTH run 1 (pilot-pdf-20260514-182836) and run 5 (pilot-pdf-20260514-190422). Both passed. The lifecycle shows run 5 as the latest (pr_candidate=true). Run 5 artifacts are authoritative for DocConverter.

F5_replay_manifest_validation.description: replay.py reads pr-candidate-manifest.json to validate publishable_candidate_count > 0. With the overwrite bug, a run that partially fails will show 0 candidates if no scenarios pass in that run.
F5_replay_manifest_validation.fix: LANE 2 merge fix resolves this — merged manifest always contains all accumulated passing candidates.

F6_package_directory_naming.description: Package directory name = scenario_id with family prefix stripped. Mapping: pdf-doc-converter → doc-converter, pdf-xls-converter → xls-converter, pdf-html → html.

F7_package_source_files_only.description: Package should contain only source files, not build artifacts (bin/obj). The existing optimizer in pdf-controlled-pilot has bin/obj artifacts — this is an anomaly. Wave A (merger/splitter) in pdf-controlled-pilot-wave1 are clean (no bin/obj). Wave B assembly should be clean.

pdf-xls-converter.note: Run 5 regression: XlsConverter re-attempted in run pilot-pdf-20260514-190422 and FAILED. Canonical passing artifacts are from run 1 (pilot-pdf-20260514-182836). Lifecycle record shows run 5 failure. Completion queue correctly shows PR_READY (set after run 1 pass).

publication_readiness.blocking_reason: APPROVE_LIVE_PR env var not set — live PR creation blocked

structural_fixes_required.change: Add merge_existing=True parameter. Read existing manifest if present. Merge: new run passes override their entries; old pass entries preserved for scenarios absent from or not improved by current run.
structural_fixes_required.also_add: build_consolidated_pr_candidate_manifest_from_lifecycle() to rebuild manifest from lifecycle records for audit/repair use

structural_fixes_required.description: Copy source files (Program.cs, .csproj, example.manifest.json, expected-output.json, README.md) from canonical run directories into workspace/pr-dry-run/pdf-controlled-pilot/examples/pdf/lowcode/{short_name}/

structural_fixes_required.change: Add regression annotation to pdf-xls-converter's run 5 entry. Note that run 1 artifacts are canonical for publication.

investigation_verdict: ARCHITECTURE_GAP_CONFIRMED — Two structural issues identified: (1) pr-candidate-manifest.json overwrites each run causing cross-run candidate loss; (2) pr-dry-run package is not populated automatically causing publish-pr to see no Wave B candidates. Both are fixable without risk to existing publications.
